The '''Recruiter for the Empire''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] badge awarded to individuals who were recognized for "''outstanding recruitment endeavors for the Empire.''"

One such badge was awarded by [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], in honor of the Imperial's recruiting efforts, due to it being recognized by High Command.

==Behind the scenes==
The Recruiter for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online-[[roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
